name: Reliability Strict Edge Protection
description: This xApp maximizes reliability by protecting edge users and reducing BLER. It increases transmit power and bandwidth when edge SINR is low or PRB utilization is high. The objective is to improve p10 SINR and reduce packet error rate. This strategy may increase interference and energy consumption. It may reduce BitPerJ because higher transmit power increases total energy usage. It prioritizes link robustness over energy efficiency.

control_parameters.semantic: Increase transmit power to improve SINR for edge users. Higher power reduces BLER but increases interference and energy usage.
Increase available PRBs to reduce resource contention and lower effective congestion. More bandwidth improves reliability but increases system load and interference.
